translation: The Yin Wei arises at the intersection of all the yin [meridians]; its vessel issues at the Zhubin point (KI9) of Foot Shaoyin, which is the xi (cleft) point of the Yin Wei, situated in the fleshy division of the calf, five cun above the inner ankle. Ascending following the inner border of the thigh, it runs up into the lower abdomen, where it joins Foot Taiyin, Jueyin, Shaoyin, and Yangming at Fushe. (Three cun below Fujie (SP14), four and a half cun from the abdominal midline.) Above, it joins Foot Taiyin at Daheng (SP15) and Fu'ai (SP16).
